group_assessment.counts_note: total_publications and publications_on_gene are 0 because no per-author output count was measured in this pass. A zero here means NOT MEASURED, not zero publications.
group_assessment.note: Research-group knowledge base excluded from the public edition; this rests on measured PubMed counts and the paper's own author and reference lists.
group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-02 (tool=LEGEND-research): 'WWOX AND TIAF1' 9 records and 'WWOX AND TIAF1 NOT Chang NS[au]' 0 records; '"TRAPPC6A" AND (aggregation OR plaque)' 4 records, all four from this laboratory; 'Zfra' 17 records and 'Zfra NOT Chang NS[au]' 1 record, which is an unrelated zebrafish androgen-receptor paper matching the string by accident; 'WWOX AND "dorsal root ganglion"' 1 record, the group's own.
group_assessment.self_citation_measured: Of this paper's 64 references 61 carry a PMID; 28 of those have Chang NS as an author, and all three PMID-less references are his (PubMed esummary author lists, 2026-10-02). That is 31 of 64, 48 percent.
group_assessment.weighting: Same laboratory as B1, B2 and B4. The paper also declares a patent held by two of its authors on the intervention it evaluates, which is a development interest in the result.

entries.proposition: Methods and Results disagree on the dosing schedule of the prevention experiment: Methods say three consecutive weekly injections, Results say four.
entries.snippet: 3-month-old 3xTg mice received Zfra4-10 peptide or PBS via tail vein injections once per week for 3 consecutive weeks

entries.proposition: Methods state five animals per group for the restoration experiment (the sentence quoted here opens 'five 10-month-old 3xTg mice'); the Figure 3 legend states ten per group and names the two groups 'sham' and 'control', naming no Zfra group at all. No sentence in the paper reconciles the two numbers. Dose and route are in this same sentence: 2 mM Zfra4-10 in 100 microlitres of PBS by tail vein, weekly.
entries.snippet: received four consecutive injections of Zfra4–10 solution (2 mM in PBS, 100 μL each injection)

entries.proposition: The paper's only WWOX-genotype cell system is mouse embryonic fibroblasts, not neurons, and the aggregation readout is a single blot with a '% increase in expression' row and no replicate count.
entries.snippet: The knockout MEF cells exhibited constitutive phosphorylation

entries.proposition: FIGURE ATTESTATION qualifying the sentence above.
